title: Advantages and disadvantages of Windows NT 3.1
excerpt: For one thing, it was very expensive to be an early adopter in this case
content_html:
I’ve talked a lot about the advantages and disadvantages of old milestone operating systems. But what were the advantages and disadvantages of Windows NT 3.1, first released July 27, 1993? That’s a fair question, and there are valid reasons it proved transformational even though it initially did anything but take the world by storm.

Windows NT 3.1 was a landmark for Microsoft: its first fully 32-bit operating system. It was the weird offspring of Windows 3.1, IBM’s OS/2, and DEC‘s VMS. How could it have three parents? Don’t ask. Just smile and nod.

OK, I’ll explain. IBM and Microsoft co-developed OS/2 as a successor to DOS, which was popular but really showing its age by the mid 1980s. But they had a fundamental disagreement over how 16-bit Windows fit into everything. Eventually the disagreements led to a very public divorce that left IBM confused. IBM soldiered alone, developing and eventually releasing OS/2 2.0 and OS/2 2.1, both of which worked rather well and gained a cult following. Microsoft took its nascent code that it intended to form the base of OS/2 3.0, renamed it Windows New Technology, and eventually released it as Windows NT 3.1.

So how does DEC VMS fit in? VMS was (and remains) an operating system for minicomputers. Microsoft hired Dave Cutler, the chief architect of VMS, to be the chief architect of Windows NT. Cutler’s work on VMS and other DEC operating systems influenced the internal workings of NT.

Being 32-bit, it was more stable than 16-bit Windows 3.1. It also had the ability to do something resembling real security. The implementation wasn’t perfect, but the capability was there. It also did real pre-emptive multitasking like OS/2 and Amiga.

Believe it or not, in 1993 there was some question whether Intel x86 would dominate the future of the CPU field. Microsoft hedged its bets by porting NT to any 32-bit chip it could think of. Its initial target was the Intel i860, then the MIPS R3000. When it was released, it ran on two architectures besides Intel x86. One was MIPS, the chip architecture later used many consumer routers, including the venerable Linksys WRT54G. The other was the ill-fated DEC Alpha, a criminally underrated chip from the 1990s. PowerPC followed in 1995, and Sun SPARC was planned. In 1993, this versatility was an advantage. Notably missing was ARM, but ARM wasn’t getting the attention other RISC chips were in 1993. But porting to ARM later proved straightforward because Windows NT was designed to be portable. So was porting to AMD64.

Aside from the improved stability and security, it had a new filesystem, NTFS, that was more efficient and faster than the ancient FAT filesystem DOS used.

NT 3.1 was mostly compatible with 16-bit Windows, and its “Windows on Windows” approach to running 16-bit apps was more transparent than OS/2’s approach.

Finally, its user interface was more familiar than OS/2. It was completely different under the hood, but if you could use Windows 3.1, you could use NT 3.1 too.

Disadvantages of Windows NT 3.1

In 1993, memory was expensive, and Windows NT wanted 16 megabytes of it. In 1993, 4 megabytes of RAM was standard and some systems still came with as little as 2. At the time, 16 MB of RAM cost around $600. The rest of the computer cost around $1,000. So you paid a 40% premium to get enough memory to run NT comfortably.

Setting up NT 3.1 was also difficult, since Plug and Play was still a couple of years off.

Driver support was also anemic. Most consumer hardware didn’t have NT drivers at first, so you had to dual boot with DOS and Windows 3.1 to use a lot of computer hardware we take for granted today. Power management was non-existent, so battery life was much better on a laptop if you ran something else. Almost anything else. It also couldn’t take advantage of power saving features of the new Energy Star PCs like an IBM PS/2E.

In the early 1990s when I would get into operating system debates, I advocated for OS/2. People always said, “What about Windows NT?” That was a short argument because I only ever met one person who ran Windows NT 3.1 on a regular basis. I was working at Best Buy and he came in with a pretty long shopping list. But we couldn’t find a sound card, CD-ROM drive, or flatbed scanner that would work with NT 3.1 at the time. Or at least I couldn’t guarantee any of it would work, since it didn’t say so on the box. DOS worked. Windows 3.1 worked. Even OS/2 usually worked. For NT, you were on your own early on. The best case scenario involved lots of hunting for and downloading drivers from BBSes and Compuserve.

Windows NT grew up, but 3.1 was a bit of a rush job and it showed. It was really NT 3.51, released in May 1995, that gained a lot of use, and NT 4.0, released in July 1996, that took Windows NT into something resembling mainstream. For several years, Windows NT was something that people talked about while they ran Windows 3.1 instead.

Windows was one of the most important changes of 1990s computing, and Windows NT had a lot to do with that, but the promise of there someday being one Windows that could be everything to everyone, and delivering it a decade later was probably a once in a lifetime event. Microsoft has to move faster than that today.

Legacy

Windows NT 3.1 is probably the most influential operating system nobody used. It lived up to its promise, as every Microsoft operating system from Windows XP onward is its direct descendant. If you ever wondered why you have to hit CTRL-ALT-DEL to log in, it was so Windows NT could get C2 Orange Book certification from the U.S. Government.

Windows NT 3.1 was Microsoft’s attempt at a “Unix killer.” That didn’t exactly happen. Both Unix and NT are far, far more widespread now than anyone had any right to imagine in 1993. But NT definitely did put a dent in proprietary Unix. There’s a lot less AIX, Solaris, and HP-UX around today. Much of that is because of Linux, but NT had something to do with it too. And Windows NT turned out to be far, far more successful than Microsoft’s ill-fated Unix product.

Oddly, even though NT was designed to leave Intel behind if necessary, it may have saved Intel’s x86 architecture. Since NT could run on cheap PCs, that was what most people bought, and they put up with the limitations of a $1,600 PC. It wasn’t as good as a $3,000 RISC workstation but it was probably better than half as good. Sustaining that market share gave Intel the cashflow it needed to eventually make x86 competitive with those other chip architectures, notably starting with the Pentium Pro. You don’t hear much talk of x86 going away anymore.

Thanks for reading

Well, this post blew up, which was unexpected but definitely a pleasant surprise. If you’ve read this far, thank you. I’ve been blogging for nearly 27 years. Today I specialize in retro tech content, and I post every weekday. I hope you’ll check out some of the content this post linked, and if you enjoyed some of it, I hope you’ll come back tomorrow. Thanks again!

David Farquhar is a computer security professional, entrepreneur, and author. He has written professionally about computers since 1991, so he was writing about retro computers when they were still new. He has been working in IT professionally since 1994 and has specialized in vulnerability management since 2013. He holds Security+ and CISSP certifications. Today he blogs five times a week, mostly about retro computers and retro gaming covering the time period from 1975 to 2000.

I was working at Best Buy and he came in with a pretty long shopping list. But we couldn’t find a sound card, CD-ROM drive, or flatbed scanner that would work with NT 3.1 at the time. Or at least I couldn’t guarantee any of it would work, since it didn’t say so on the box. DOS worked. Windows 3.1 worked. Even OS/2 usually worked. For NT, you were on your own early on. The best case scenario involved lots of hunting for and downloading drivers from BBSes and Compuserve.

sentences.en: In the early 1990s when I would get into operating system debates, I advocated for OS/2.
sentences.zh: 在 20 世纪 90 年代初期，当我卷入操作系统争论时，我主张使用 OS/2。

sentences.en: People always said, “What about Windows NT?”
sentences.zh: 人们总是问：“Windows NT 怎么样？”

sentences.en: That was a short argument because I only ever met one person who ran Windows NT 3.1 on a regular basis.
sentences.zh: 这是一个简短的争论，因为我只见过一个定期运行 Windows NT 3.1 的人。

sentences.en: I was working at Best Buy and he came in with a pretty long shopping list.
sentences.zh: 我在百思买工作，他进来时带着一份很长的购物清单。

sentences.en: But we couldn’t find a sound card, CD-ROM drive, or flatbed scanner that would work with NT 3.1 at the time.
sentences.zh: 但当时我们找不到支持 NT 3.1 的声卡、CD-ROM 驱动器或平板扫描仪。

sentences.en: Or at least I couldn’t guarantee any of it would work, since it didn’t say so on the box.
sentences.zh: 或者至少我不能保证其中任何一个都能起作用，因为盒子上没有这么说。

sentences.en: DOS worked.
sentences.zh: DOS 工作了。

sentences.en: Windows 3.1 worked.
sentences.zh: Windows 3.1 可以工作。

sentences.en: Even OS/2 usually worked.
sentences.zh: 甚至 OS/2 通常也能工作。

sentences.en: For NT, you were on your own early on.
sentences.zh: 对于 NT 来说，你很早就只能靠自己了。

sentences.en: The best case scenario involved lots of hunting for and downloading drivers from BBSes and Compuserve.
sentences.zh: 最好的情况是从 BBS 和 Compuserve 大量寻找和下载驱动程序。

blocks.html_en: Windows NT grew up, but 3.1 was a bit of a rush job and it showed. It was really NT 3.51, released in May 1995, that gained a lot of use, and NT 4.0, released in July 1996, that took Windows NT into something resembling mainstream. For several years, Windows NT was something that people talked about while they ran Windows 3.1 instead.

sentences.en: Windows NT grew up, but 3.1 was a bit of a rush job and it showed.
sentences.zh: Windows NT 不断发展壮大，但事实证明 3.1 的工作有点仓促。

sentences.en: It was really NT 3.51, released in May 1995, that gained a lot of use, and NT 4.0, released in July 1996, that took Windows NT into something resembling mainstream.
sentences.zh: 实际上，1995 年 5 月发布的 NT 3.51 获得了广泛的使用，而 1996 年 7 月发布的 NT 4.0 使 Windows NT 成为了主流。

sentences.en: For several years, Windows NT was something that people talked about while they ran Windows 3.1 instead.
sentences.zh: 多年来，Windows NT 一直是人们在运行 Windows 3.1 时谈论的话题。

blocks.html_en: Windows was one of the most important changes of 1990s computing, and Windows NT had a lot to do with that, but the promise of there someday being one Windows that could be everything to everyone, and delivering it a decade later was probably a once in a lifetime event. Microsoft has to move faster than that today.

sentences.en: Windows was one of the most important changes of 1990s computing, and Windows NT had a lot to do with that, but the promise of there someday being one Windows that could be everything to everyone, and delivering it a decade later was probably a once in a lifetime event.
sentences.zh: Windows 是 20 世纪 90 年代计算领域最重要的变革之一，Windows NT 对此有很大关系，但承诺有一天会出现一款可以为每个人提供一切的 Windows，并在十年后交付它可能是一生一次的事件。

sentences.en: Microsoft has to move faster than that today.
sentences.zh: 微软必须比现在更快地采取行动。

blocks.html_en: Legacy

sentences.en: Legacy
sentences.zh: 遗产

blocks.html_en: Windows NT 3.1 is probably the most influential operating system nobody used. It lived up to its promise, as every Microsoft operating system from Windows XP onward is its direct descendant. If you ever wondered why you have to hit CTRL-ALT-DEL to log in, it was so Windows NT could get C2 Orange Book certification from the U.S. Government.

sentences.en: Windows NT 3.1 is probably the most influential operating system nobody used.
sentences.zh: Windows NT 3.1 可能是最有影响力但无人使用的操作系统。

sentences.en: It lived up to its promise, as every Microsoft operating system from Windows XP onward is its direct descendant.
sentences.zh: 它兑现了它的承诺，因为从 Windows XP 开始的每个 Microsoft 操作系统都是它的直系后代。

sentences.en: If you ever wondered why you have to hit CTRL-ALT-DEL to log in, it was so Windows NT could get C2 Orange Book certification from the U.S. Government.
sentences.zh: 如果您想知道为什么必须按 CTRL-ALT-DEL 才能登录，那么 Windows NT 就可以获得美国政府的 C2 橙皮书认证。

blocks.html_en: Windows NT 3.1 was Microsoft’s attempt at a “Unix killer.” That didn’t exactly happen. Both Unix and NT are far, far more widespread now than anyone had any right to imagine in 1993. But NT definitely did put a dent in proprietary Unix. There’s a lot less AIX, Solaris, and HP-UX around today. Much of that is because of Linux, but NT had something to do with it too. And Windows NT turned out to be far, far more successful than Microsoft’s ill-fated Unix product.

sentences.en: Windows NT 3.1 was Microsoft’s attempt at a “Unix killer.”
sentences.zh: Windows NT 3.1 是微软对“Unix 杀手”的尝试。

sentences.en: That didn’t exactly happen.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有完全发生。

sentences.en: Both Unix and NT are far, far more widespread now than anyone had any right to imagine in 1993.
sentences.zh: Unix 和 NT 现在的普及程度远远超出 1993 年任何人的想象。

sentences.en: But NT definitely did put a dent in proprietary Unix.
sentences.zh: 但 NT 确实削弱了专有的 Unix。

sentences.en: There’s a lot less AIX, Solaris, and HP-UX around today.
sentences.zh: 如今，AIX、Solaris 和 HP-UX 已经很少了。

sentences.en: Much of that is because of Linux, but NT had something to do with it too.
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上是因为 Linux，但 NT 也有一定关系。

sentences.en: And Windows NT turned out to be far, far more successful than Microsoft’s ill-fated Unix product.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，Windows NT 比微软命运多舛的 Unix 产品要成功得多。

blocks.html_en: Oddly, even though NT was designed to leave Intel behind if necessary, it may have saved Intel’s x86 architecture. Since NT could run on cheap PCs, that was what most people bought, and they put up with the limitations of a $1,600 PC. It wasn’t as good as a $3,000 RISC workstation but it was probably better than half as good. Sustaining that market share gave Intel the cashflow it needed to eventually make x86 competitive with those other chip architectures, notably starting with the Pentium Pro. You don’t hear much talk of x86 going away anymore.

sentences.en: Oddly, even though NT was designed to leave Intel behind if necessary, it may have saved Intel’s x86 architecture.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，尽管 NT 的设计目的是在必要时将 Intel 抛在后面，但它可能拯救了 Intel 的 x86 架构。

sentences.en: Since NT could run on cheap PCs, that was what most people bought, and they put up with the limitations of a $1,600 PC.
sentences.zh: 由于 NT 可以在廉价 PC 上运行，因此大多数人都购买了 NT，并且他们忍受了 1,600 美元 PC 的限制。

sentences.en: It wasn’t as good as a $3,000 RISC workstation but it was probably better than half as good.
sentences.zh: 它不如 3,000 美元的 RISC 工作站好，但可能好过一半以上。

sentences.en: Sustaining that market share gave Intel the cashflow it needed to eventually make x86 competitive with those other chip architectures, notably starting with the Pentium Pro.
sentences.zh: 维持这一市场份额为英特尔提供了最终使 x86 与其他芯片架构（尤其是从 Pentium Pro 开始）竞争所需的现金流。

sentences.en: You don’t hear much talk of x86 going away anymore.
sentences.zh: 你不会再听到太多关于 x86 消失的言论了。

blocks.html_en: David Farquhar is a computer security professional, entrepreneur, and author. He has written professionally about computers since 1991, so he was writing about retro computers when they were still new. He has been working in IT professionally since 1994 and has specialized in vulnerability management since 2013. He holds Security+ and CISSP certifications. Today he blogs five times a week, mostly about retro computers and retro gaming covering the time period from 1975 to 2000.

content_html_zh:
我已经谈论了很多旧的里程碑操作系统的优点和缺点。 但是 1993 年 7 月 27 日首次发布的 Windows NT 3.1 有哪些优点和缺点呢？ 这是一个公平的问题，并且有充分的理由证明它具有变革性，尽管它最初并没有引起世界风暴。

Windows NT 3.1 是 Microsoft 的一个里程碑：它的第一个完全 32 位操作系统。 它是 Windows 3.1、IBM 的 OS/2 和 DEC 的 VMS 的奇怪后代。 怎么可能有三个父母呢？ 别问。 只需微笑并点头即可。

好的，我会解释一下。 IBM 和 Microsoft 共同开发了 OS/2，作为 DOS 的继承者，DOS 很流行，但到 20 世纪 80 年代中期才真正显示出它的过时之处。 但他们对于 16 位 Windows 如何适应一切存在着根本性的分歧。 最终，这些分歧导致了一场非常公开的离婚，这让 IBM 感到困惑。 IBM 孤军奋战，开发并最终发布了 OS/2 2.0 和 OS/2 2.1，这两个版本都运行良好并获得了狂热的追随者。 微软采用了旨在构成 OS/2 3.0 基础的新生代码，将其重命名为 Windows 新技术，并最终将其发布为 Windows NT 3.1。

那么 DEC VMS 如何融入其中呢？ VMS 曾经（并且仍然是）小型计算机的操作系统。 微软聘请VMS的首席架构师Dave Cutler担任Windows NT的首席架构师。 Cutler 在 VMS 和其他 DEC 操作系统方面的工作影响了 NT 的内部运作。

由于是 32 位，它比 16 位 Windows 3.1 更稳定。 它也有能力做一些类似于真正安全的事情。 实施并不完美，但能力已经存在。 它还像 OS/2 和 Amiga 一样实现了真正的抢占式多任务处理。

不管你相信与否，1993 年有人质疑 Intel x86 是否会主宰 CPU 领域的未来。 微软通过将 NT 移植到它能想到的任何 32 位芯片上来对冲它的赌注。 它最初的目标是Intel i860，然后是MIPS R3000。 当它发布时，它运行在除 Intel x86 之外的两种架构上。 其中之一是 MIPS，该芯片架构后来用于许多消费级路由器，包括古老的 Linksys WRT54G。 另一个是命运多舛的 DEC Alpha，这是 20 世纪 90 年代一款被严重低估的芯片。 1995 年 PowerPC 紧随其后，Sun SPARC 也在计划中。 1993 年，这种多功能性是一种优势。 值得注意的是 ARM 的缺失，但 ARM 在 1993 年并没有像其他 RISC 芯片那样受到关注。 但后来证明移植到 ARM 很简单，因为 Windows NT 被设计为可移植的。 移植到 AMD64 也是如此。

除了改进的稳定性和安全性之外，它还具有新的文件系统 NTFS，它比 DOS 使用的古老 FAT 文件系统更高效、更快。

NT 3.1 大部分与 16 位 Windows 兼容，其运行 16 位应用程序的“Windows on Windows”方法比 OS/2 的方法更加透明。

最后，它的用户界面比 OS/2 更熟悉。 其本质是完全不同的，但如果您可以使用 Windows 3.1，那么您也可以使用 NT 3.1。

Windows NT 3.1 的缺点

1993 年，内存非常昂贵，Windows NT 需要 16 MB。 1993 年，4 MB RAM 已成为标准配置，有些系统的 RAM 容量仍然只有 2 MB。 当时，16 MB RAM 的价格约为 600 美元。 电脑的其余部分售价约为 1,000 美元。 因此，您支付了 40% 的费用来获得足够的内存来舒适地运行 NT。

设置 NT 3.1 也很困难，因为即插即用还需要几年时间。

驾驶员支持也很薄弱。 大多数消费类硬件一开始都没有 NT 驱动程序，因此您必须使用 DOS 和 Windows 3.1 双启动才能使用我们今天认为理所当然的许多计算机硬件。 电源管理不存在，所以如果你运行其他东西，笔记本电脑的电池寿命会长得多。 几乎任何其他东西。 它还无法利用 IBM PS/2E 等新型能源之星 PC 的节能功能。

在 20 世纪 90 年代初期，当我卷入操作系统争论时，我主张使用 OS/2。 人们总是问：“Windows NT 怎么样？” 这是一个简短的争论，因为我只见过一个定期运行 Windows NT 3.1 的人。 我在百思买工作，他进来时带着一份很长的购物清单。 但当时我们找不到支持 NT 3.1 的声卡、CD-ROM 驱动器或平板扫描仪。 或者至少我不能保证其中任何一个都能起作用，因为盒子上没有这么说。 DOS 工作了。 Windows 3.1 可以工作。 甚至 OS/2 通常也能工作。 对于 NT 来说，你很早就只能靠自己了。 最好的情况是从 BBS 和 Compuserve 大量寻找和下载驱动程序。

Windows NT 不断发展壮大，但事实证明 3.1 的工作有点仓促。 实际上，1995 年 5 月发布的 NT 3.51 获得了广泛的使用，而 1996 年 7 月发布的 NT 4.0 使 Windows NT 成为了主流。 多年来，Windows NT 一直是人们在运行 Windows 3.1 时谈论的话题。

Windows 是 20 世纪 90 年代计算领域最重要的变革之一，Windows NT 对此有很大关系，但承诺有一天会出现一款可以为每个人提供一切的 Windows，并在十年后交付它可能是一生一次的事件。 微软必须比现在更快地采取行动。

遗产

Windows NT 3.1 可能是最有影响力但无人使用的操作系统。 它兑现了它的承诺，因为从 Windows XP 开始的每个 Microsoft 操作系统都是它的直系后代。 如果您想知道为什么必须按 CTRL-ALT-DEL 才能登录，那么 Windows NT 就可以获得美国政府的 C2 橙皮书认证。

Windows NT 3.1 是微软对“Unix 杀手”的尝试。 但这并没有完全发生。 Unix 和 NT 现在的普及程度远远超出 1993 年任何人的想象。 但 NT 确实削弱了专有的 Unix。 如今，AIX、Solaris 和 HP-UX 已经很少了。 这很大程度上是因为 Linux，但 NT 也有一定关系。 事实证明，Windows NT 比微软命运多舛的 Unix 产品要成功得多。

奇怪的是，尽管 NT 的设计目的是在必要时将 Intel 抛在后面，但它可能拯救了 Intel 的 x86 架构。 由于 NT 可以在廉价 PC 上运行，因此大多数人都购买了 NT，并且他们忍受了 1,600 美元 PC 的限制。 它不如 3,000 美元的 RISC 工作站好，但可能好过一半以上。 维持这一市场份额为英特尔提供了最终使 x86 与其他芯片架构（尤其是从 Pentium Pro 开始）竞争所需的现金流。 你不会再听到太多关于 x86 消失的言论了。

感谢您的阅读

好吧，这篇文章火了，这出乎意料，但绝对是一个惊喜。 如果您已经读到这里，谢谢。 我写博客已有近 27 年了。 今天，我专注于复古科技内容，每个工作日都会发布。 我希望您能查看这篇文章链接的一些内容，如果您喜欢其中的一些内容，我希望您明天再来。 再次感谢！

David Farquhar 是一位计算机安全专家、企业家和作家。 他自 1991 年起就开始撰写有关计算机的专业文章，因此他在复古计算机还很新的时候就撰写了有关它们的文章。 他自 1994 年以来一直从事 IT 专业工作，并自 2013 年以来专门从事漏洞管理。 他拥有 Security+ 和 CISSP 认证。 如今，他每周写五次博客，主要是关于 1975 年至 2000 年期间的复古电脑和复古游戏。
